source_documents.title: Insights into solvents and substituents modulating green-to-red emission of quinacridone from locally excited-state and intramolecular charge transfer

reference_evidence_units.quote: The introduction of steric substituents into the quinacridone (QA) backbone effectively inhibits π-π stacking interactions, thereby opening up the radiative transition channel of the molecules and enhancing fluorescence intensity.
reference_evidence_units.subject: QA-OMe and QA-TPA
reference_evidence_units.statement: N-aryl groups prevent π-π stacking quenching.

reference_evidence_units.quote: is assigned to the observed emission band of QA-OMe at 538.6 nm, corresponding to a locally excited (LE) transition from HOMO to LUMO
reference_evidence_units.subject: QA-OMe
reference_evidence_units.statement: QA-OMe emission is LE, not CT.
